mapper.sql: task_id, scene_type, idempotent_key, method_class, method_name, method_params, hook_class, method_param_types, backoff_strategy, backoff_base, retry_intervals, task_status, submit_mode, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, error_msg, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retry_task ( task_id, scene_type, idempotent_key, method_class, method_name, method_params, hook_class, method_param_types, backoff_strategy, backoff_base, retry_intervals, task_status, submit_mode, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{sceneType}, #{idempotentKey}, #{methodClass}, #{methodName}, #{methodParams}, #{hookClass}, #{methodParamTypes}, #{backoffStrategy}, #{backoffBase}, #{retryIntervals}, #{taskStatus}, #{submitMode}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE retry_task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE retry_task SET task_status = 'EXECUTING', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND task_status IN ('INIT', 'WAIT')
UPDATE retry_task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE retry_task SET update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'EXECUTING'
UPDATE retry_task SET task_status = 'INIT', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE retry_task SET task_status = 'INIT', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_status = 'EXECUTING' AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(update_time) * 1000 < #{timeoutMillis}
